set.body: Acceptance criteria: scalar equality, inequality, and ordered comparisons do not allocate temporary scalar NDArrays; scalar-left arithmetic and comparisons are available where mathematically meaningful; direct scalar minimum and maximum avoid scalar-array construction; all primitive dtypes preserve documented comparison, overflow, NaN, infinity, and signed-zero semantics; public syntax and overloads compile on Scala 3.7.4 without weakening rank inference; JVM and full-linked Scala.js allocation/performance evidence covers every scalar path promised for 1.0; and exact semantic tests pass on both platforms.
set.title: Complete allocation-free scalar comparisons and scalar-left APIs
